## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes and why.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance / refactoring improvement

## Quality Checklist
Before submitting this PR, please confirm the following:
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](file:///CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass (`pnpm test`).
- [ ] Code follows formatting standards (`pnpm format`).
- [ ] Linters and strict type checks pass (`pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck`).
- [ ] Production build succeeds and bundle size stays within budget (`pnpm build && pnpm check:bundle`).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have updated any relevant documentation.
